commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+1' Samuele Angori (Pisa) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Pisa earn a corner.
87' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
86' Stefano Sabelli comes off the pitch to be replaced by Sebastian Otoa (Genoa).
86' Vitinha (Genoa) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
85' Genoa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
80' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lorenzo Colombo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
78' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Amorim and he is replaced by Vitinha (Genoa).
76' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Adrian Semper is alert and denies him.
70' A substitution has been made. Idrissa Toure goes off and Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) comes on.
70' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Rafiu Durosinmi replaces him.
68' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) has received a yellow card for his foul.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Junior Messias (Genoa) coming on for Tommaso Baldanzi.
65' It is time for a substitution. Jean Onana (Genoa) is on for Jeff Ekhator.
61' The substitution has been made. Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) has replaced Ebenezer Akinsanmiro.
61' Oscar Hiljemark has decided to make a change. Isak Vural (Pisa) replaces Arturo Calabresi.
56' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Felipe Loyola as he is replaced by Henrik Meister (Pisa).
55' 1 - 2 Goal! Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) puts the ball into the top left corner past the outstretched arm of Adrian Semper.
54' Handball! A player from Pisa handled the ball. Genoa are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
53' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Pisa.

51' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
50' The linesman makes the right call and Genoa will have a corner.

50' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Adrian Semper pulls off a brilliant save.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Genoa win a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes just over the bar.
43' Pisa have a corner.

42' 1 - 1 Goal! Tommaso Baldanzi finds Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the top right corner. Fantasy football! 1:1.
32' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
29' The ball is out of play. Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner.
28' Genoa have a free kick.
23' Samuele Angori (Pisa) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Justin Bijlow.
22' Genoa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

19' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header down inside the right post. 1:0.
18' Pisa force a corner. They send men into the box.
14' Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
11' That was close by Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
10' Aaron Martin (Genoa) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
7' Genoa are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
